guestBioOfficial.en: Naomi Gleit is head of product at Meta, joined as employee #29, and is the longest-serving executive at Meta other than Mark Zuckerberg. She’s been at the center of some of the company’s most foundational products, including Facebook’s early growth team. In our conversation, we discuss: • How she originally landed at Facebook
guestBioOfficial.zh: 娜奥米·格莱特是Meta的产品主管，曾以第29号员工的身份加入公司，是除马克·扎克伯格外在Meta任职时间最长的高管。她参与了该公司最基础的产品开发，包括Facebook的早期增长团队。在我们的对话中，我们将讨论：•她最初如何进入Facebook

summary.en: Naomi stresses creating a single "canonical doc" for every project to drive extreme clarity and avoid conflicting answers. She shares lessons from Meta's legendary early growth team and how to ramp up fast on any new initiative. The episode is a rare, practical master class in product leadership from inside Meta's senior ranks.
summary.zh: 娜奥米强调为每个项目建立唯一的"权威文档"（canonical doc），以实现极度清晰、避免答案相互矛盾。她分享了 Meta 传奇早期增长团队的经验，以及如何快速上手任何新项目。本期是一份来自 Meta 高层的罕见而实用的产品领导力大师课。
